title: Dictator response under a satisfied constraint
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game, let $ho$ assign an alphabet coordinate to each vertex, and choose a vertex $v$, a neighbour $w$ of $v$, and a query $x$ in the Boolean cube. If the permutation on this constraint sends the coordinate assigned to $w$ to the coordinate assigned to $v$, then the response of the dictator code induced by $ho$ at $v$ on query $x$ and neighbour $w$ equals the dictator response at $v$ on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A labeling ρ of vertices by alphabet coordinates
A vertex v and a neighbour w of v
The constraint permutation sends ρ(w) to ρ(v)
